name: Aurora
desc: Aurora borealis curtains hang and ripple over the upper frame — vertical light rays folding across a magenta-topped green sheet with a broad glowing wash beneath, sitting over any night scene as pure emitted light.

hue.doc: base curtain hue (default green; tips shift +70)

fold.doc: waviness / pleating of the curtain hemline

band.doc: vertical extent of the lit band

style.doc: borealis=green with magenta tops (hue-tinted) / ion=cyan-violet / blood=rare red aurora / mono=austere silver-green
